controls.name: Exposure compensation dial
controls.default_function: Adjusts exposure compensation; positive values increase exposure and negative values reduce it.

controls.name: DRIVE button
controls.default_function: Displays drive options for still image, continuous, bracketing, motion panorama, multiple exposure, and advanced filter modes.

controls.name: Auto mode selector lever

positions.description: Select from P (program AE), S (shutter-priority AE), A (aperture-priority AE), and M (manual) modes.

controls.default_function: Selects manual exposure modes P, S, A, and M, or auto mode.

controls.name: Shutter speed dial
controls.default_function: Selects shutter speed; A selects automatic shutter speed, T selects a timed exposure, and B holds the shutter open while the shutter button is pressed.

controls.name: Control ring options button / Function button (Fn7)
controls.default_function: Displays control ring options; Fn7 is assigned to control ring options by default and its function-button role is assignable.

controls.name: Focus mode selector
controls.default_function: Selects single AF, continuous AF, or manual focus.

controls.name: Aperture ring
controls.default_function: Sets aperture; A lets the camera select aperture.

controls.name: Control ring
controls.default_function: Provides the selected control-ring function; DEFAULT varies by shooting mode. In manual focus mode, it adjusts focus distance.

controls.name: Front ring
controls.default_function: Remove to attach the optional wide conversion lens.

controls.name: ON/OFF switch
controls.default_function: Turns the camera on or off.

controls.name: Shutter button
controls.default_function: Half-presses to focus and lock focus and exposure; press fully to take a picture.

controls.name: Movie-record button / Function button (Fn1)
controls.default_function: Starts and stops movie recording by default; its function-button role is assignable and the assigned role is accessed by pressing and holding.

controls.name: b (delete) button / Function button (Fn8)
controls.default_function: Deletes pictures in playback; Fn8 has no function assigned by default and can be assigned.

controls.name: a (playback) button
controls.default_function: Starts playback.

controls.name: Command control
controls.default_function: Press left or right to choose shutter speed and aperture combinations or fine-tune shutter speed, and to zoom during playback; press the center to zoom in on the selected focus area. Press and hold the center during manual focus to choose a focus-assist display.

controls.name: Q (quick menu) button
controls.default_function: Displays the quick menu; press and hold to display quick-menu edit options.

controls.name: Selector/function buttons
controls.default_function: Highlights items; up selects AF mode, left selects self-timer, right selects flash mode, and down selects the focus area by default. These directions are assignable as function buttons Fn2–Fn5.

controls.name: MENU/OK button / X (control lock) button
controls.default_function: Opens menus and selects items; press and hold to lock or unlock the selector, Q, Fn6, and AF-L/AE-L buttons during shooting.

controls.name: Wi-Fi button / Function button (Fn6)
controls.default_function: Wireless options are assigned to Fn6 by default; its function-button role is assignable.

controls.name: DISP (display)/BACK button
controls.default_function: Cycles display modes and serves as BACK in menus; press and hold to display function-button role settings.

controls.name: AF-L/AE-L (autofocus/autoexposure lock) button
controls.default_function: AE lock only by default; lock behavior can be set to remain active while pressed or until the button is pressed again.

controls.name: LCD tilt switch
controls.basis: Recorded native input/display qualification in native/web/INPUTS.md: GPIO1.1, record 0xb63a84/event 0x515 and completed panel command 0x36. Two switch states are declared; mechanical angle and panel orientation are unmeasured.

controls.name: LCD monitor (touchscreen)
controls.default_function: Touch controls are off by default; touch mode can be set to touch shooting or focus-area selection.

controls.name: Battery-chamber cover latch
controls.default_function: Slide the battery-chamber latch as shown and open the battery-chamber cover.

controls.name: Battery latch
controls.default_function: To remove the battery, press the battery latch to the side, and slide the battery out of the camera as shown.
